title: A role with Create & Edit but no Delete sees the tracking switch on and disabled
custom_preconds:
• A custom role: Part Library & Inventory with View and Create & Edit ticked, Delete unticked. A user signed in with only that role.
  • Parts > Inventory, Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Fill Description, Part Number, Category, Cost and a bin quantity, then Save.
  3. Replay POST /api/inventory/parts/create from DevTools with isTracked false.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • Track quantities and cost of goods is ON and disabled (cannot be switched off).

Step 2:

  • The tracked part saves and shows its available quantity.

Step 3:

  • 201: the API accepts an untracked create for this role (D14, by design; do not log a bug).
